references.text: The context for the naming of the place; the Lord's fire burned among the people because of their complaints
Taberah is mentioned as a place where Israel provoked the Lord's anger
Another example of God's judgment by fire/burning punishment against Israel's sin in the wilderness
The Lord's fire went out and consumed Nadab and Abihu; parallel to divine fire as judgment
The Lord rained down fire and sulfur on Sodom; God's fire as judgment over sin
Our God is a consuming fire; thematic connection to God's judging fire
